name: Belarusian
notes: East Slavic, Cyrillic, sibling of Ukrainian. Cleanroom RULE g2p (src/languages/belarusian/, mirrors the uk iotated/palatalisation engine): akanne is SPELLED (о only stressed -> [o]) so no stress dict. Signatures: г->ɣ, retroflex ж/ш/ч->ʐ/ʂ/t͡ʂ (+ дж->d͡ʐ, дз->d͡z), unique ў->u̯/w, і IOTATED (Іван->jivan, unlike uk), э->ɛ vs soft е->(j)e, dark л->ɫ, palatalisation before ь/і/iotated, and — unlike uk — regressive VOICING + final devoicing (горад->ɣorat). REGRESSIVE PALATALISATION (sibilant с/з/ц/дз softens before a palatalised coronal/labial, not velar; н->nʲ before a palatalised affricate) was the iterative lever 90.9%->97.2%. Slavic-decimal numbers. 97.2% FOLDED vs wikipron bel_cyrl_narrow (HUMAN, 7259); residual = loanword г->[ɡ] tail (Ghana/Riga) + rare clusters. name: Danish

Referee-eval measures the RULE engine NON-CIRCULARLY = 27.4% FOLDED (the honest novel-word floor; low because Danish vowel quality/reduction/stress is largely LEXICAL). Lexicon covers 97.3% of the referee (common words) at reference quality (Kobenhavn->kob@n'hAwn, gade->'gaeð@). HONEST folds: stod/aspiration/length/dots + a~ɑ (modelling tested, LOST -> noise); ae/e/aa/o qualities KEPT DISTINCT (folding them inflated +8pp). 🟡 bounded — a neural OOV g2p (bn-tagger pattern) is the path past the rule floor. name: Hebrew
notes: Modern Israeli Hebrew, the abjad. Normally written UNVOCALIZED → full task is vowel restoration; all three core layers now in place. PHASE 1: niqqud→IPA segmental g2p on VOCALIZED input, 87.1% folded vs en.wiktionary vocalized→a=IL IPA (2561w, single-source) — bgdkpt dagesh (בּ=b/ב=v…), ⟨ש⟩ shin/sin, ⟨ו⟩ shuruk/holam-male, patach genuvah, mater lectionis. name: Haitian Creole
notes: French-lexified creole of Haiti (~12M), Latin (the phonemic IPN orthography, Pressoir-Faublas 1979). The 3rd creole in the fleet (after kea + Nigerian Pidgin pcm). Greedy scan + the nasal-vowel rule: ⟨ou⟩→u, ⟨ui⟩→ɥi, ⟨ch⟩→ʃ, ⟨è ò⟩→ɛ ɔ; Haitian ⟨r⟩→[ɣ] (→[w] before a rounded vowel, ayeropò→ajewopɔ), ⟨j⟩→ʒ, ⟨y⟩→j. THE CORE: nasal vowels ⟨an en on⟩→[ã ɛ̃ ɔ̃] syllable-finally (nan→nã, lang→lãɡ), oral before a true vowel (Dominik→dominik), nasal before a glide (anyen→ãjɛ̃), doubled ⟨nn⟩→nasal+n; ⟨i⟩/⟨ou⟩ don't nasalize (machin→maʃin, moun→mun); geminate collapse. 97.7% FOLDED / 99.4% symbol vs wikipron hat_latn_broad (1691 human; 96.9% first pass). Backbone strips the nasal tilde → nasal comparison is base-vowel; engine emits ã ɛ̃ ɔ̃. Folds: rhotic ɣ~ʁ~ɰ, loan nasals õ→ɔ̃, stress (unmarked). 🔷 single source. Deferred: numbers, full variable-⟨r⟩ model. See docs/investigations/ht_native_bringup_investigation.md.

name: Maori
notes: Eastern Polynesian, New Zealand (~185k), Latin — one of the SIMPLEST orthographies in the fleet (near-1:1 phonemic). Direct grapheme g2p: 5 vowels + MACRON=LENGTH (ā ē ī ō ū→aː eː iː oː uː), ⟨p t k m n h w⟩, ⟨r⟩→[ɾ] tap, digraphs ⟨wh⟩→[ɸ] (whenua→ɸenua) + ⟨ng⟩→[ŋ] (tangata→taŋata). Strict CV — no codas/clusters/glides (Aotearoa→aoteaɾoa). Stress (mora-based, unwritten) not emitted. 99.8% FOLDED / 100.0% symbol on the FIRST pass vs wikipron mri_latn_broad (1005 human; the only 2 misses = the non-Māori glyph Ḵ). Folds: rhotic r~ɾ, ⟨wh⟩ ɸ~f. 🔷 single-source-family (broad+narrow same Wiktionary scrape) but near-ceiling. Deferred: mora-stress model, numbers. See docs/investigations/mi_native_bringup_investigation.md.

name: Macedonian
notes: South Slavic, Cyrillic, fully phonemic + no vowel reduction: grapheme scan + shared phonotactics (dark-l, syllabic-r, final devoicing, n→ŋ) + distinct palatal letters (ѓ ќ љ њ ѕ џ ј) + FIXED antepenult stress. wikipron mkd_cyrl_narrow 99.0% folded / 99.8% symbol (63024 headwords, near-ceiling).

name: Mongolian (Khalkha)
notes: Standard Khalkha, Cyrillic. Greedy g2p + the DEEP-orthography rules (non-initial short-vowel reduction to one reduced-vowel phoneme / word-final deletion + epenthesis; хурга->xurəɢ), aspirated-vs-unaspirated stop system (б=p т=tʰ), л->ɮ, back-harmony г->ɢ/х->χ, final н->ŋ, final в->f devoicing, doubled->long, iotated е/ё/я/ю, palatalizing ь. 52.5% FOLDED vs en.wiktionary Mongolian (1342 Cyrillic words, NARROW/phonetic) — single-source; the % understates quality (narrow referee + loanword full-vowel tail needing a lexicon), native common-word output is sound. + cardinal numbers + a mixed-harmony loanword heuristic + a Mongol-bichig (traditional-script) front-end (transliterate->Cyrillic, 33% on 118 words). See docs/investigations/mn_native_bringup_investigation.md

name: Mossi (Mooré)
notes: FIRST Gur language in the fleet. Wolof-shaped greedy g2p + gemination + nasal assimilation from the Latin (Burkinabé) orthography. DUAL-GROUNDED: 94.9% folded vs en.wiktionary Moore (39w, single numeric referee, loanword-heavy) + the FSI Moré Basic Course (Lehr/Redden/Balima 1966) phonology (corroborates ⟨r⟩=flap-of-/d/, ⟨o⟩=/o/ no ⟨ɔ⟩, ⟨ny⟩=ɲ, /n/=[n,ŋ], H/L tone). Signatures: ATR letters ⟨ɛ ɩ ʋ⟩, doubling=length, tilde=nasal, ⟨r⟩=ɾ, ⟨y⟩=j, geminate Cː, ⟨n⟩→ŋ before g/k. Tone (2-tone H/L) unwritten→not emitted. Numbers deferred.

name: Maltese
notes: The ONLY Semitic language in the LATIN alphabet (Malti; Siculo-Arabic core + Sicilian/Italian/English). Fairly phonemic → greedy grapheme scan + the silent-letter rules + assimilation. Signatures: ⟨q⟩→ʔ, ⟨ċ⟩→t͡ʃ, ⟨ġ⟩→d͡ʒ, ⟨ħ⟩→ħ, ⟨x⟩→ʃ, ⟨z⟩→t͡s vs ⟨ż⟩→z; ⟨għ⟩ silent (colours the vowel)/[ħ] final, ⟨h⟩ silent medial/[ħ] final, ⟨ie⟩→ɪ; final devoicing + regressive voicing assimilation + affricate gemination (⟨ġġ⟩→dd͡ʒ) + n→m before a labial. 93.0% FOLDED / 98.2% symbol vs wikipron mlt_latn_broad (15,837 human). Vowel LENGTH folded (stress-conditioned Arabic-style weight, deferred). 🔷 single-source but LARGE. Deferred: weight-based stress + length, numbers, ⟨għ⟩-as-glide. See docs/investigations/mt_native_bringup_investigation.md.

name: Norwegian Bokmål
notes: North Germanic, Latin, Urban East Norwegian. TWO-TIER: an NST pronunciation lexicon (National Library of Norway, CC0, INDEPENDENT of the Wiktionary referee; ~38k common forms, ~98% of real-text tokens, carrying lexical stress + vowel quality) -> a cleanroom RULE g2p fallback (phonemizeWordRules; COMPLEMENTARY VOWEL LENGTH picks quality ⟨o⟩->uː/ɔ, ⟨u⟩->ʉː/ʉ, ⟨å⟩->oː/ɔ; front-vowel softening sk/k/g->ʃ/ç/j; digraphs sj/skj->ʃ, kj/tj->ç, hv->ʋ; retroflex r+coronal->ʈ/ɳ/ɭ/ʂ barn->bɑːɳ; silent final ⟨d⟩ god->ɡuː; unstressed ⟨e⟩->ə). Western-composer numbers. Referee kaikki/wikipron is dictionary-shaped so the raw uniform % is deflated; the honest signal = the FREQUENCY-WEIGHTED metric (freq/nb.txt, OpenSubtitles, wired into referee-eval): 90.7% shipped (lexicon->rules) vs 63.4% rules-only, and NST corroborates the rule engine independently (breaks single-source). OOV tier (async phonemizeNbNeural): a stress-predicting BiLSTM tagger (ONNX, structuralTagger contract, trained on the full 631k NST with the stress mark in the tag alphabet -> predicts stress POSITION + vowel quality from spelling), held-out far above the perceptron prototype (56.6%); onnxruntime-node optional, falls back to sync. Folds: pitch accent (unwritten->deferred), rhotic ɾ~ʁ, low-vowel ɑ~a. 🟢 bounded: vowel/stress closed by lexicon+tagger, irreducible remainder = pitch accent (not orthographically encoded). See docs/investigations/nb_native_bringup_investigation.md

name: Occitan
notes: Occitano-Romance (Gallo-Romance), southern France (~200k), beyond-espeak. Added for FLEURS coverage. The classical orthography is PAN-DIALECTAL (one spelling → dialect-specific readings) → targets LANGUEDOCIEN (the koine + most-likely FLEURS reader dialect; FLEURS audio dialect unverified). Greedy Gallo-Romance scan: unstressed ⟨o⟩→[u], final ⟨a⟩→[ɔ], ⟨u⟩→[y]/[w], ⟨ò⟩→ɔ; ⟨c g⟩ softening, ⟨lh⟩→ʎ ⟨nh⟩→ɲ ⟨ch⟩→t͡ʃ ⟨j⟩→d͡ʒ ⟨v⟩→b; intervocalic ⟨s⟩→z; ⟨i⟩→[j] before vowel; final devoicing; LANGUEDOCIEN final-consonant deletion (word-final ⟨n r⟩ after vowel drops: Japon→dʒapu, cantar→kanta; final-r +11pp). 70.4% FOLDED / 93.3% symbol vs wikipron oci_latn_broad (675 human, dialect-mixed — noisy proxy). Folds: rhotic ʁ~ɾ, spirantization β/ð/ɣ→b/d/ɡ, ch t͡s~t͡ʃ, final-a spread, stress. kaikki (1136) is Béarn/Niçard-tagged → unusable as Languedocien gold. 🔷 thin + dialect-mixed. Deferred: dialect overrides (Gascon/Provençal/Niçard) as a `dialect` param — NOT attempted (no clean per-dialect data), stress, numbers. See docs/investigations/oc_native_bringup_investigation.md.

name: Slovak
notes: West Slavic, sibling of Czech (cs). Cleanroom RULE g2p (src/languages/slovak/, mirrors the cs engine): palatalisation d/t/n/l->ɟ/c/ɲ/ʎ before soft i/í/e (y/ý HARD: milý->miliː), rising diphthongs ia/ie/iu->ɪ̯a/ɪ̯e/ɪ̯u + ô->u̯ɔ, ä->æ, syllabic l̩/r̩ (long ĺ/ŕ), ľ=ʎ h=ɦ ch=x, gemination, regressive voicing + final devoicing ⟨v⟩ devoices to [f] only in ONSET before a voiceless obstruent (vták->ftaːk), stays [v] in coda/final (stav->stav) unlike cs v->f. Cardinal numbers (paucal agreement, like cs). 89.0% FOLDED vs wikipron slk_latn_broad (HUMAN, 15950); common-word 88.0% ≈ proper-noun 91.2%. Palatalisation before ⟨e⟩ is LEXICAL (deti vs ten) — modelled as a rule (referee majority, +12pp) with a loan/exception tail. Deferred: a kaikki/exception lexicon (cs precedent) for the loanword non-palatalisation tail. See docs/investigations/sk_native_bringup_investigation.md

name: Umbundu
notes: Bantu (R11, Angola). Greedy Latin g2p (Chichewa/Shona pattern, open CV) authored from the Schadeberg (1982) 'Nasalization in UMbundu' (primary R11 phonology): VOICED obstruents ONLY prenasalised (mb/nd/nj/ng->ᵐb/ⁿd/ᶮd͡ʒ/ᵑɡ), c->t͡ʃ (palatal, not [ʃ]), v->v, no native /r/ (r->l), ñ/ny->ɲ, ng'->ŋ, l->l, plain p/t/k + f/s/h. 5 oral + 5 nasal vowels (no length). REFEREE-SCARCE: no wikipron/kaikki/epitran/Wiktionary-IPA; the ASJP Umbundu-3 wordlist (coarse, orthography-free) corroborates the inventory only. Hand-adjudicated gold in test/umbundu.test.ts (Igbo/Naija no-referee pattern — a distinct documented language, not a clone). Tone (H/L+downstep, unwritten) + cardinal numbers DEFERRED. 🔷 single-source. See docs/investigations/umb_native_bringup_investigation.md

name: Standard Malay
notes: ALIAS to the Indonesian engine (served_by=id) — a labelled approximation, like bgc->hi. Malay and Indonesian are mutually intelligible standardisations of the same Malayic language, sharing the reformed Latin orthography and ~the same grapheme->IPA phonology; NO independent Malay referee wired, and the documented differences (Malaysian final open <a> -> [ə], some vowel realisations) are accent-level, not a categorical delta.
